attBesluta.text: Purchased this for my RV. Heavy duty and well made. Best one I've seen out there. Highly recommend. Price is right too.
Its great. Drill a hole through the middle so water drains.
Feels heavy, seems to be of really good quality, very happy.
Strong and Robust, I use these on two different travel trailers for the tongue and they work great. The plastic has seen no degredation or damage due to crushing pressure.
Outstanding product, just make sure to center the trailer tongue shoe.

This is very solid. I wish I had ordered the dual package, one for my camper trailer and one for my caravan. They are currently out of stock but will be ordering the second one as soon as they become available. Recommended for the good price and solid contruction
